verifications.claim: As of April 2026, Amazon has reached a new agreement with the U.S. Postal Service (USPS).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Amazon.com on Monday announced it reached a new agreement with the U.S. Postal Service on package deliveries" (R1, dated April 6, 2026); similar announcements in R2-R6
verifications.reasoning: All references directly report the new agreement announced in April 2026.

verifications.claim: The agreement ensures USPS retains about 80% of its existing Amazon delivery volume.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "retain about 80% of its existing ‌deliveries from its biggest customer" (R1); "Amazon will retain about 80% of ​its existing deliveries ​with USPS" (R2, R3, R4); similar in R5, R6
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly state the agreement maintains about 80% of existing Amazon delivery volume for USPS.

verifications.claim: The agreement ensures USPS retains over 1 billion packages annually.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "or more than ‌1 ⁠billion packages per year" (R2, R3, R4); "or more than 1 billion packages per year" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly quantify the retained volume as more than 1 billion packages per year.

verifications.claim: Amazon is investing $4 billion to speed up rural deliveries.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Amazon said it ⁠would spend more than $4 billion to expand its U.S. rural delivery network" (R1, R5); "$4 billion expansion focused on rural and small-town communities" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: References confirm $4B investment in rural delivery expansion, but specify 'expand' rather than explicitly 'speed up'.

verifications.claim: Amazon frequently utilizes USPS for the final delivery leg to homes.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "auction off access to its last‑mile delivery network" (R1, R5); context of rural deliveries and partnership
verifications.reasoning: References imply USPS role in last-mile (final leg) deliveries via network access and rural focus, but do not explicitly state 'frequently utilizes' or 'to homes'.

verifications.claim: Reports indicate USPS delivered roughly 1.7 billion packages annually for Amazon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "USPS delivered about 1.7 billion packages annually for Amazon" (R1, R5)
verifications.reasoning: References directly quote the Postmaster General reporting approximately 1.7 billion packages annually.

verifications.claim: The Amazon-USPS partnership began around 2013 with Sunday delivery services.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "partnership that has spanned more than three decades" (R4, R6)
verifications.reasoning: References state the partnership spans more than three decades (pre-2013), contradicting a 2013 start; no mention of Sunday delivery.
